testcase.name: the workout card counts a record only against earlier sessions
a rolling week against the one before, skipping unlogged days
the trend has one point per session, oldest first, ignoring warm-ups
the split gives fat a quarter and carbohydrate the rest
less help is the record on an assisted machine
a month starts on its weekday and is padded to whole weeks
a heavy set gets the full ramp, rounded down to plates
plates are largest first and exact when the gym stocks them
a weight the plates cannot make says how far short it falls
records name the best, the heaviest and the most reps
repeated plates are counted, and the bar alone is said plainly
Mifflin-St Jeor matches the published equation
months shift across the year end
below the bar is flagged, and other bars subtract their own weight
targets scale with goal and never cut below resting energy
a light set gets a short ramp, and the bar alone needs none
the rep max table runs Epley backwards and rounds down to small plates
water is 35 ml a kilo in glasses, at least eight
